sample.title: Why Condos Are Getting Harder To Buy
sample.description:
Buying a condo may be about to become significantly more difficult, even for buyers with good financial standing. Beginning August 3rd, Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac are making big changes to how condominium mortgages are reviewed. Streamlined review process that applied to many transactions will now be retired. Instead, lenders will now have to conduct a more comprehensive review of a the building before the mortgage can go to Fannie Mae or Freddie Mac.

New fund hopes to save 100 of the world's most threatened species | BBC News
sample.description:
A new fund is working to save 100 of the world's most threatened species. 

The Phoenix Species Project will put $200m (£149m) towards restoring animals in the wild and stopping them from going extinct. It's one of the largest funds ever focused on species recovery. 

The project is a collaboration between the Bezos Earth Fund and Re:wild - a non profit co-founded by actor Leonardo DiCaprio. 

It comes at a time when conservationists have warned about a decline in global biodiversity, and just a few weeks after the Trump administration rolled back endangered species protections.
